questions.question: What does the passage say about the importance of this treatise, even though it has some difficulties?
questions.answer: It says the work is still very important and special despite those problems.

questions.question: Which respected Muslim figure is said to have foretold this work?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What two names were given to this treatise in that foretelling?
questions.answer: It was called the Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What does it mean that Imam Ali directed people’s attention toward this work?
questions.answer: It means he pointed people to it as something valuable and worthy of notice.

questions.question: What event is mentioned as confirming Imam Ali’s prediction?
questions.answer: The events in Denizli are said to have confirmed it.

questions.question: How did the printing of the book affect the writers or supporters of it?
questions.answer: Its secret printing led to their imprisonment.

questions.question: What is given as a main reason for their release?
questions.answer: The strength and victory of the book’s sacred truth is given as a main reason.

questions.question: What is this treatise described as explaining?
questions.answer: It is described as explaining the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: How is the treatise connected to the Seventh Ray?
questions.answer: It is also identified as the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How many main parts does the treatise have?
questions.answer: It has an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What is included in the Introduction?
questions.answer: It presents four important matters.

questions.question: What is found in the First Station and the Second Station?
questions.answer: The First Station has the Arabic part of the explanation, and the Second Station gives its translation with proofs.

questions.question: Why does the writer say the Introduction became long?
questions.answer: He says its length shows there was a real need for that much explanation.

questions.question: What interesting reaction does the writer expect from some readers about the Introduction?
questions.answer: Some may still think it is too short even though it is long.

questions.question: According to the verse at the end of the passage, why were jinn and human beings created?
questions.answer: They were created to worship Allah.

questions.question: What is the main message in the opening part of the passage about the treatise?
questions.answer: The message is that the work has great value even if it is not easy in every way.

questions.question: Who is presented as having special insight about this work before it was written?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: Why is his mention of the work important in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows the treatise is being presented as honored and meaningful.

questions.question: What later events are used as evidence that the prediction was true?
questions.answer: The imprisonment connected to the book and the later acquittal are used as evidence.

questions.question: What cause-and-effect relationship is described between the book and the imprisonment?
questions.answer: The hidden printing of the book is said to have caused the imprisonment.

questions.question: What cause-and-effect relationship is described between the book’s truth and the acquittal?
questions.answer: The power and success of its truth are said to have led to acquittal and release.

questions.question: What does the passage say the treatise is an explanation of?
questions.answer: It says the treatise explains the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: Besides being an explanation, what other title or place does the treatise have?
questions.answer: It is also the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How is the whole treatise organized?
questions.answer: It is divided into an Introduction, a First Station, and a Second Station.

questions.question: What is the job of the First Station?
questions.answer: It contains the Arabic section of the explanation.

questions.question: What is the job of the Second Station?
questions.answer: It gives the translation of that explanation along with proofs.

questions.question: What basic purpose of creation is stated in the verse at the end?
questions.answer: The purpose stated is worship of Allah.

questions.question: In this passage, how is the treatise presented overall?
questions.answer: It is presented as a highly important religious work with special honor.

questions.question: Which companion of the Prophet, peace be upon him, is mentioned with respect and prayer?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What did he supposedly do concerning this treatise?
questions.answer: He is said to have foretold it and named it.

questions.question: What historical incident is brought in to support that claim?
questions.answer: The Denizli events are brought in as support.

questions.question: What happened because the book was printed secretly?
questions.answer: The people involved were imprisoned.

questions.question: What positive outcome followed after that hardship?
questions.answer: They were cleared and released.

questions.question: According to the passage, what helped bring about that positive outcome?
questions.answer: The triumph of the book’s holy and powerful truth helped bring it about.

questions.question: What does the passage identify as the subject explained by the treatise?
questions.answer: The subject is the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What title links this work to a numbered part of a larger collection?
questions.answer: The title Seventh Ray links it to that collection.

questions.question: How many sections are named in the structure of the treatise?
questions.answer: Three sections are named: the Introduction, the First Station, and the Second Station.

questions.question: What kind of material is in the First Station compared with the Second Station?
questions.answer: The First Station has the Arabic explanation, while the Second Station has the translation and supporting evidence.

questions.question: What reason does the writer give for the length of the Introduction?
questions.answer: He says the length points to a need for such explanation.

questions.question: How does the final verse connect with the rest of the passage?
questions.answer: It reminds readers that the whole discussion is tied to the purpose of worshipping Allah.

questions.question: Even with flaws and hard parts, what judgment does the passage make about this treatise?
questions.answer: It judges the treatise to be very important.

questions.question: Whose earlier recognition of the treatise is mentioned?
questions.answer: Imam Ali’s earlier recognition is mentioned.

questions.question: What are the two special names connected to this work?
questions.answer: They are the Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: Which city’s events are mentioned as support for this claim?
questions.answer: Denizli.

questions.question: What trouble came from producing the book in secret?
questions.answer: It brought imprisonment.

questions.question: What blessing came afterward according to the passage?
questions.answer: There was acquittal and deliverance.

questions.question: How does the passage connect that blessing to the book itself?
questions.answer: It connects it to the strength and victory of the truths in the book.

questions.question: What verse-related role does the treatise have?
questions.answer: It serves as an explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What place does it hold within the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: It is the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What are the three major parts named in the treatise?
questions.answer: The Introduction, the First Station, and the Second Station.

questions.question: What does the Introduction contain?
questions.answer: It contains four important matters.

questions.question: What is the difference between the First Station and the Second Station?
questions.answer: The First Station gives the Arabic exposition, and the Second Station gives its translation with proofs.

questions.question: Why does the writer say the Introduction is long?
questions.answer: He says its length shows there was a need for it.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the Qur’anic verse placed at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It means jinn and human beings were created to worship Allah.

questions.question: What tension appears at the start of the passage about this treatise?
questions.answer: The passage says it has difficulties, yet it is still extremely important.

questions.question: Who is named as having miraculously known of its coming?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What action did he take besides foretelling it?
questions.answer: He also gave it special names and pointed people toward it.

questions.question: What real-life events are said to back up this view?
questions.answer: The imprisonment over the book and the later release are said to back it up.

questions.question: What led to the imprisonment?
questions.answer: The secret printing of the book led to it.

questions.question: What led to acquittal and release according to the passage?
questions.answer: The winning strength of the book’s sacred truth led to that.

questions.question: What does the passage call the treatise in relation to a verse?
questions.answer: It calls it an explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What does the passage call it in relation to the larger work?
questions.answer: It calls it the Seventh Ray, also designated as the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: How is the treatise arranged for the reader?
questions.answer: It is arranged into an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What does each main part do?
questions.answer: The Introduction gives four major matters, the First Station gives the Arabic exposition, and the Second Station gives the translation and proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer say about his intention for the Introduction’s length?
questions.answer: He says he did not mean to make it that long.

questions.question: If he did not intend that length, why does he think it happened?
questions.answer: He thinks it happened because the subject needed that much explanation.

questions.question: What central duty is highlighted by the Qur’anic verse included at the end?
questions.answer: It highlights worshipping Allah.

questions.question: How does the passage balance weakness and worth when speaking about the treatise?
questions.answer: It admits the treatise has difficulties but says its worth is still very great.

questions.question: Which honored person is mentioned as giving advance notice of the work?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What are the two titles connected with that advance notice?
questions.answer: The titles are the Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What episode is mentioned as confirming the earlier prediction?
questions.answer: The episode mentioned is what happened in Denizli.

questions.question: In that episode, what role did the hidden printing of the book play?
questions.answer: It was the reason they were imprisoned.

questions.question: In that same episode, what role did the book’s truth play?
questions.answer: It was a chief reason for their acquittal and rescue.

questions.question: What is the treatise said to explain?
questions.answer: It explains the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What double identity does the treatise have in the passage?
questions.answer: It is both an explanation of the Supreme Verse and the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What are the main divisions of the treatise?
questions.answer: They are the Introduction, the First Station, and the Second Station.

questions.question: What content belongs to the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four important matters belong to it.

questions.question: What content belongs to the First and Second Stations?
questions.answer: The First Station has the Arabic exposition, and the Second Station has the translation plus proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer say about making the Introduction long on purpose?
questions.answer: He says that was not his intention.

questions.question: Then what explanation does he give for its length?
questions.answer: He says the length itself shows there was a need.

questions.question: According to the verse placed at the end, what is the purpose of jinn and mankind?
questions.answer: Their purpose is to worship Allah.
